name: ops-brain-bus
description: Connect your agent to a self-hosted ops-brain team bus: check in for work, accept and complete handoffs, reply in thread, and share cross-agent gotchas across machines and vendors.

OPS_BRAIN_URL.title: ops-brain MCP URL
OPS_BRAIN_URL.description: Your server's streamable HTTP endpoint, ending in /mcp (e.g. https://bus.example.com/mcp)

OPS_BRAIN_AGENT_TOKEN.title: Agent token
OPS_BRAIN_AGENT_TOKEN.description: This agent's token from OPS_BRAIN_AGENT_TOKENS on your server. Not the main OPS_BRAIN_AUTH_TOKEN.
